This small plot is my perennial patch — I think it is my coffee and a few fruit trees near the house. It has been there for years, and I mostly give it manure from my cattle because chemical fertilizer for trees is expensive and I would rather put my little cash on the maize plot where I see the return faster. The trees are already established so I do not need seed this year, and the rains here in Oromia are usually enough, so I will not irrigate. My wife and I will weed and prune when we have time between the other plots.
